rows.question: Identify a list of genes expressed in lung cancer
rows.pred_sql:
WITH differential_expression_by_disease AS (
  SELECT
    de.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,
    de.doid AS doid
  FROM differential_expression de
),
cancer_tissue_to_anatomy AS (
  SELECT
    ct.doid AS doid,
    ct.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM cancer_tissue ct
),
healthy_expression_by_anatomy AS (
  SELECT
    ensembl_gene_id,
    uberon_anatomical_id
  FROM healthy_expression
)
SELECT DISTINCT gene_symbol
FROM (
  -- Genes from differential expression in lung-related diseases:
  -- include diseases whose name contains 'lung' OR diseases linked in cancer_tissue rows whose uberon id mentions 'lung'
  SELECT de.gene_symbol
  FROM differential_expression_by_disease de
  WHERE de.doid IN (
    SELECT id FROM disease WHERE name ILIKE '%lung%'
    UNION
    SELECT doid FROM cancer_tissue_to_anatomy WHERE uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%'
  )

  UNION

  -- Genes normally expressed in lung anatomy (map ensembl -> gene_symbol)
  SELECT x.gene_symbol
  FROM healthy_expression_by_anatomy he
  JOIN xref_gene_ensembl x ON x.ensembl_gene_id = he.ensembl_gene_id
  WHERE he.uberon_anatomical_id ILIKE '%lung%'
) t
WHERE gene_symbol IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gene_symbol

rows.question: What are the name of cancer types where the A1BG gene expression is significantly increased (up regulated)
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT d.name AS disease_name
FROM differential_expression der
JOIN disease d ON der.doid = d.id
WHERE der.gene_symbol = 'A1BG'
  AND (
    lower(coalesce(der.expression_change_direction, '')) IN ('up', 'increased')
    OR (
      lower(coalesce(der.statistical_significance, '')) LIKE '%significant%'
      AND lower(coalesce(der.expression_change_direction, '')) = 'up'
    )
  )
  AND d.name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.name

rows.question: Get the biomarker gene symbol and biomarker description for disease with name 'breast cancer'
rows.pred_sql:
WITH biomarker_core AS (
  SELECT
    b.id,
    b.gene_symbol,
    b.biomarker_description
  FROM biomarker b
),
disease_core AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    name
  FROM disease
),
biomarker_to_disease_explicit_links AS (
  -- link via biomarker_edrn.uberon_anatomical_id -> cancer_tissue.uberon_anatomical_id -> disease.doid
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    d.id AS disease_id,
    'biomarker_edrn_uberon_to_cancer_tissue' AS link_source,
    be.uberon_anatomical_id AS link_detail
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN biomarker_edrn be ON be.id = b.id
  JOIN cancer_tissue ct ON ct.uberon_anatomical_id = be.uberon_anatomical_id
  JOIN disease d ON d.id = ct.doid

  UNION

  -- link via biomarker_edrn.phase matching disease.id (only numeric phases)
  SELECT
    b.id AS biomarker_id,
    d.id AS disease_id,
    'biomarker_edrn_phase_matches_disease' AS link_source,
    be.phase AS link_detail
  FROM biomarker b
  JOIN biomarker_edrn be ON be.id = b.id
  JOIN disease d ON CAST(be.phase AS bigint) = d.id
  WHERE be.phase ~ '^[0-9]+$'
)
SELECT
  bc.gene_symbol,
  bc.biomarker_description
FROM biomarker_core bc
JOIN biomarker_to_disease_explicit_links l ON bc.id = l.biomarker_id
JOIN disease_core d ON d.id = l.disease_id
WHERE d.name = 'breast cancer'
